About Me

I Craft Creatives That Keep Converting Long After The Click

Hi, I’m Safiya — a creative strategist and copywriter who likes following an idea all the way through. I turn business opportunities into creative strategies built for growth.

Nearly five years in DTC beauty and wellness has helped me build a simple working style: research deeply, ideate thoughtfully, execute decisively. If something works, scale it. If it doesn’t, learn quickly and build the next version.

The goal is always the same: make creatives that earn attention and turn it into measurable growth.

02Consumer Psychology Turning Audience Research Into Actionable Segments Result: 4 audience segments · 20+ campaign hypotheses

I turned one broad skincare audience into four motivation-led segments for SkinKraft’s 98% Snail Mucin Serum, and mapped a distinct message to each.

Skills AppliedConsumer psychology · Buying behaviour · Audience segmentation · Customer insights

How The Segments Were Built

01

Listen

Reviews, forums, search language and customer conversations.

02

Analyse

Shopify behaviour, GA data, Meta performance and CRM segments.

03

Group

Recurring concerns, aspirations, objections and purchase triggers.

04

Map

A message, promise and creative direction for every audience segment.

Four Audience Segments

Two axes decided the map: whether the customer is led by an aspiration or a concern, and whether she is convinced by an outcome or by proof.

Aspiration-Led · Outcome-Led

Glass-Skin Seekers

Motivation
Plump, glossy, Korean-inspired skin
Message
Intense hydration with a glass-like finish
Aspiration-Led · Proof-Led

Ingredient-First Explorers

Motivation
Discovering high-performance skincare ingredients
Message
98% snail mucin in an advanced daily serum
Concern-Led · Outcome-Led

Dehydration Fixers

Motivation
Tightness, dullness and rough texture
Message
Long-lasting hydration and smoother-feeling skin
Concern-Led · Proof-Led

Early Anti-Aging Planners

Motivation
Fine lines, elasticity and changing skin texture
Message
Firmer, healthier-looking skin with consistent use

In Their Words

  • “I want that plump glass-skin finish.”
  • “My skin looks dull again by afternoon.”
  • “Fine lines are starting to show.”
  • “Is 98% snail mucin better than a regular serum?”

Language pulled from reviews, forums and search — then used verbatim in ad copy.

Results

4Actionable audience segments identified

03Creative Strategy & Testing Building A Structured Creative Testing System Result: 100+ executions tested · Anti-aging won at 5× the average CTR

I built four campaign territories for the Snail Mucin Serum — one per audience motivation — and tested 100+ executions to find which message could scale.

Skills AppliedCreative angles · Hooks · Creative briefs · Static & video ads

From Insight To Launch

01

Define The Insight

What each audience wants, fears or struggles to solve.

02

Build The Territory

A clear campaign idea around the audience motivation.

03

Develop The Hooks

Multiple promises, problems, results and curiosity-led openings.

04

Adapt The Format

Static ads, UGC, video, demonstrations and offer-led creatives.

05

Launch Controlled Tests

One primary variable tested at a time across comparable ad sets.

Four Creative Territories

One territory per motivation, so performance could be read as a verdict on the idea — not on the execution.

Glass-Skin SeekersWants a plump, glossy finish

Glass Skin Obsession

Example message: plump, glossy, glass-like skin.

Dehydration FixersHydration never seems to last

The Broken Moisture Seal

Example message: stop hydration from leaking out.

Moved Forward For Scaling

Early Anti-Aging PlannersWants to act before lines settle in

The Anti-Aging Secret

Example message: firmer-looking skin in 28 days. Delivered 5× higher CTR than the average tested territory.

Ingredient-First ExplorersBuys the ingredient, not the promise

98% Ingredient Proof

Example message: high-concentration snail mucin care.

Results

4Audience-led campaign territories
30+Hooks and messaging variations
100+Static and video executions
5Repeatable creative formats

Anti-aging emerged as the strongest territory

  • 5× higher CTR than the average tested territory
  • Strongest performance across multiple formats and ad sets

Tools UsedMeta Ads Manager · Figma · Adobe · Claude Design

Strategic Decision

I moved Anti-Aging into deeper testing and stopped investing in weaker campaign territories. The next test focused on finding which message within that territory could balance attention with conversion.

07CRM & Lifecycle Growth Driving Repeat Growth Through Lifecycle Marketing Result: Repeat purchase +28% · Email revenue +35%

I designed a 60-day post-purchase email journey for Snail Mucin customers that increased repeat purchase by 28% and cross-sell by 22%.

Skills AppliedEmail marketing · Customer retention · Cross-sell · Lifecycle marketing

The 60-Day Email Journey

Every send had one job and one action to encourage. Subject lines, send timing and offers were A/B tested against a control before each flow went live, and the winning variant became the new baseline.

Day 1

Start The Routine

“Your serum is here — start with this step”

Application guidance and routine placement

Day 7

Build Consistency

“One week in — keep the moisture locked”

Hydration tips and usage reminders

Day 14

Notice The Progress

“Softer skin by now? Here’s what’s next”

Expected changes in softness, texture and glow

Day 28

Reward The 28-Day Result

“28 days in — your restock is 20% off for the next 48 hours”

Progress check-in, a 20% restock offer open for 48 hours, and a review request

Day 45

Complete The Routine

“Your serum works harder with these two”

Relevant Moisturizer and Sunscreen recommendations

Day 60

Keep The Progress Going

“Running low? Don’t restart from zero”

Next-purchase communication and customer benefits

Education→Consistency→Results→ Limited-time offer→Cross-sell→Next purchase

Results

+28%Repeat purchase
+22%Cross-sell conversion
+35%Email-generated revenue
3×Customer review volume
25+A/B tests run across the flow

Tools UsedCleverTap · Mailchimp · Kaleyra · Shopify

Strategic Decision

Strong product adoption and repeat demand showed that Snail Mucin could grow beyond one hero serum into a complete skincare range.
